## Professional Summary

Biomedical researcher with specialised expertise in single-cell genomics, epigenetics, and computational analysis of immune and respiratory disease. PhD-trained in genetics with subsequent postdoctoral experience leading computational analyses of interstitial lung disease (ILD) at one of Australia's leading medical research institutes. Co-first author of a comprehensive pan-ILD single-cell atlas of bronchoalveolar lavage and contributor to multiple high-impact manuscripts in *Nature* and other peer-reviewed journals. Recipient of competitive national research funding and recognised with a national society award for excellence in oral presentation.

## Current Appointments

**Postdoctoral Researcher** · Sept 2023–present
Translational Genomics Program, Garvan Institute of Medical Research, Sydney
*Supervisor: Professor Joseph Powell*

- Lead computational analyses of single-cell multi-omic data in interstitial lung disease (ILD) and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF)
- Coordinate multi-institutional collaborative studies, including an international collaboration with Professor Nick Banovich (TGen, USA) providing access to a 200-patient IPF lung explant multiome dataset
- Mentor junior researchers on experimental study design and advanced computational methodologies
- Co-first author of a comprehensive pan-ILD single-cell atlas of bronchoalveolar lavage (Allen & Zhang et al., *PLOS ONE*, 2026)

**Conjoint Lecturer** · Aug 2024–present
School of Biomedical Sciences, UNSW Medicine and Health, Sydney

## Prior Employment

**PhD Candidate Researcher** · 2018–2023
HudsonAlpha Institute for Biotechnology, Huntsville, AL, USA

- Researched the epigenetics of autoimmune diseases including Systemic Sclerosis and Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
- Developed methylation-specific assays to identify lupus-specific signals in patient blood samples
- Created bioinformatic pipelines to analyse genome-wide methylation and expression data

**Cell Manufacturing Associate** · 2017–2018
Cognate Biosciences, Memphis, TN, USA

- Modified immune cell populations to target the Epstein-Barr virus antigen in patients with childhood lymphoma

**Allograft Processing Technician** · 2016–2017
Derma Sciences Inc., USA

- Processed amniotic and chorionic tissues from postnatal placentas for use as allografts for lesions and eye injuries

## Technical Expertise

**Computational and bioinformatic:** single-cell RNA sequencing analysis; single-cell ATAC sequencing analysis; multi-omic data integration; gene regulatory network inference; differential expression and trajectory analysis; whole-genome and epigenome-wide association studies; pipeline development (Nextflow, Snakemake); high-performance and cloud computing.

**Programming:** R, Python, Bash, Git.

**Wet-lab:** methylation-specific assay development; cell-based immune modification (CAR-T background); tissue processing for clinical-grade allograft applications.

**Disease areas:** interstitial lung disease, idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, systemic lupus erythematosus, systemic sclerosis, Epstein-Barr virus-related lymphomas.
